caps.text: SNOOZING ISN'T WHAT'S RUINING YOUR MORNINGS..

slides.text:
**56%** of mornings in a study of 3 million nights ended in a snooze.
you're **normal**.

in a lab study, **30 minutes of snoozing** didn't make regular snoozers groggier.
they did **slightly better** on tests right after.

grogginess after waking can last **up to about half an hour**.
after a short night it lasts **longer**.
what heavy snoozers did have: **messier sleep schedules**.
students with **regular sleep times** got better grades than irregular ones, on **similar hours** of sleep.

the part that eats your morning:
**6 in 10** people under 30 are on their phone within **10 minutes** of waking.

what fixed mine: my apps **stay asleep** until i've **walked 200 steps**.
snooze all you want. **tiktok waits**.

**sources**
Robbins 2025
